response.sql: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_usage FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS station_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS station_fraction FROM station_averages GROUP BY lunarstage
